chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from one of his companions, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Mihran, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about a man who had intercourse with his sister. He said: 'He should be struck with one strike of the sword.' I said: 'So he would be finished (from it)?' He said: 'He should be imprisoned forever until he dies.'
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a man who commits adultery with his sister according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines the specific penal ruling for a man committing adultery with his sister, prescribing execution by the sword. The Imam’s clarification that the individual is imprisoned permanently until death indicates that the single strike serves as the method of execution rather than a corporal punishment that concludes the sentence, reflecting the severity of incestuous relations in Shia jurisprudence.
